description_en: Updates the recording configuration for an application and saves the output to OSS
description_zh: 更新配置APP录制，输出内容保存到OSS中
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-app-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name 'liveApp****' --oss-endpoint learn.developer.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveAppRecordConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of OSS.

To store live streaming recordings in OSS, you must create an OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Endpoint名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The start time of the recording. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The specified time must be within 7 days after the actual stream ingest starts. This parameter takes effect only for stream-level recording, which means the StreamName parameter is not empty
parameters.help_zh: 录制开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 设置的时间必须是实际推流时间开始7天之内，只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the recording. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The difference between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 7 days. If the difference exceeds 7 days, the recording duration is calculated as 7 days. This parameter takes effect only for stream-level recording, which means the StreamName parameter is not empty
parameters.help_zh: 录制结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EndTime与StartTime相差不应超过7天，超过7天将按照7天计算。只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable on-demand recording. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Uses HTTP callbacks.
2: Parses stream ingest parameters for on-demand recording.
7: Does not record by default. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html operation to manually start or stop recording.

If OnDemand is set to 1, you must call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html operation to configure OnDemandUrl first. Otherwise, recording is disabled by default
parameters.help_zh:
按需录制。取值：

0：关闭。
1：通过HTTP回调方式。
2：解析推流参数按需录制。
7：默认不录制，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html接口手动控制录制开启或停止。

当OnDemand取值为1时，需要先通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html接口配置OnDemandUrl，否则默认不录制
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en:
The stream interruption concatenation duration.
If the stream interruption duration exceeds the specified concatenation duration, a new file is generated. Valid values: 15 to 21600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
断流拼接时长。
直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持15~21600秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
The epoch recording length. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 6 hours.

If a stream is interrupted during a recording epoch but Normal stream ingest resumes within the stream interruption concatenation duration, the stream continues to be recorded in the same file.
A recording file is generated only after a stream is interrupted for a duration that exceeds the stream interruption concatenation duration
fields.help_zh:
周期录制时长。单位：秒。不填则默认为6小时。

如果在一个录制周期内，直播流发生了断流，但是在断流拼接时长内，该直播流又正常推流，那么仍会在同一个录制文件中继续录制。
一条直播流必须断流超过断流拼接时长，才会生成录制文件
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The recording format. M3U8, FLV, MP4, and CMAF are supported. Valid values:

<notice>You must specify at least one of RecordFormat and TranscodeRecordFormat. If you select the m3u8 or cmaf format, you must also specify the RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration request parameters.
</notice>

m3u8
flv
mp4
cmaf
fields.help_zh:
格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：

<notice>RecordFormat和TranscodeRecordFormat两者至少需要设置一个。如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The segment length. Unit: seconds.

<notice>This parameter takes effect only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 30 seconds. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才有效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en: The epoch recording length for transcoding streams. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 6 hours
fields.help_zh: 转码流录制周期录制时长。单位：秒。不填则默认为6小时
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The recording format for transcoded streams. M3U8, FLV, MP4, and CMAF are supported. Valid values:
<notice>If you select the m3u8 or cmaf format, you must also specify the TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration request parameters.
</notice>

m3u8
flv
mp4
cmaf
fields.help_zh:
转码流录制格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：
<notice>这如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The segment length for transcoded stream recording. Unit: seconds.

<notice>This parameter takes effect only when TranscodeRecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 30 seconds. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
转码流录制单个切片时长，单位：秒。

<notice>当TranscodeRecordFormat.N.Format（转码流录制格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才生效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

parameters.help_en: The transcoded stream recording format details
parameters.name: transcode_record_format

parameters.help_en: The transcoding template group for transcoded stream recording
parameters.help_zh: 转码流录制的转码模板组
parameters.name: transcode_templates
